routes.name: Dozvola za privremeni boravak i rad stranca (Jedinstvena dozvola)

note: Serbia, read in the Law on Foreigners (Zakon o strancima, Official Gazette of the Republic of Serbia 24/2018, 31/2019 and 62/2023) in the consolidated text Paragraf Lex publishes, on 2026-10-30; the official legal information system (pravno-informacioni-sistem.rs) serves its text only through a script, so the publisher's text is cited as secondary. Temporary residence on the ground of employment is granted as the single permit for residence and work, applied for electronically through the single portal by the foreigner or the employer on their behalf, from abroad or during lawful stay (either); the competent body decides within 15 days of a complete application; temporary residence is granted for up to three years and may be extended for the same period. Work on the single permit follows the law on the employment of foreigners (read as work for the sponsor); a foreigner granted temporary residence on another ground or permanent settlement may work without one. A prescribed fee is payable but its amount (the Law on Republic Administrative Fees) wasn't read. Permanent settlement (stalno nastanjenje) is granted to one who has resided continuously three years on temporary residence (absences up to ten months in all or six at once), so 3 is kept; it is applied for while holding temporary residence (in country), and its holder may work. Naturalisation's years aren't in this law and aren't kept.

sources.title: Zakon o strancima (Sl. glasnik RS, br. 24/2018, 31/2019 i 62/2023), Paragraf Lex consolidated text
sources.said: Privremeni boravak može se odobriti u trajanju do tri godine i može se produžavati na isti period, u zavisnosti od postojanja razloga zbog kojih se privremeni boravak odobrava. ... U slučajevima iz stava (1) tač. 2)-4) i 6)-14) ovog člana izdaje se dozvola za privremeni boravak, a u slučajevima iz tač. 1) i 5) jedinstvena dozvola. ... Na osnovu jedinstvene dozvole stranac ima pravo na privremeni boravak i rad u Republici Srbiji, u skladu sa zakonom. ... Zahtev za izdavanje, odnosno produženje jedinstvene dozvole stranac, poslodavac u ime stranca, odnosno lice koje oni ovlaste, podnosi elektronski, putem jedinstvenog portala. ... jedinstvene dozvole podnosi iz inostranstva. ... U postupku izdavanja jedinstvene dozvole plaća se propisana taksa, u skladu sa zakonom. ... O zahtevu za izdavanje jedinstvene dozvole odlučuje nadležni organ u roku od 15 dana od dana prijema urednog zahteva. ... Stalno nastanjenje odobriće se strancu koji ispunjava uslove iz člana 70. ovog zakona i koji u Republici Srbiji boravi neprekidno tri godine na osnovu odobrenja privremenog boravka.
